interpretation.primary: In this current physical tracer model, density reconstruction is carried almost entirely by the galaxy-count channel; velocity-only leaves density weakly correlated. The joint density correlation is nearly the counts-only result.
interpretation.velocity: Velocity observations are still informative for velocity prediction; heldout velocity gains were 324 (velocity-only truth0), 267 (counts-only truth0), 168 (velocity-only truth5), and 105 (counts-only truth5).
interpretation.coverage: All nominal 68-percent physical-density coverages are about 69-70 percent for Z7, consistent with the declared development gate. This is not an observational calibration certificate.
interpretation.spectral: Shell correlations and log-density variance contractions vary by channel and k; no hard low/high boundary or post-hoc power correction is selected.
interpretation.science_consequence: Do not expect CF4 peculiar velocities alone to create a detailed z=0 density map under this likelihood. Counts/source selection and the tracer model are the present limiting information path.

limits: four chains per case and two truth cases
no actual CF4 data, IC, PM forward run, or LG 0.3 cMpc/h claim

next_recommendation.purpose: Use the source result to design a count/tracer likelihood audit: verify CF4 count provenance/selection and bias identifiability before attempting higher resolution or IC construction.
mandatory: retain velocity as a velocity constraint, not silently convert it to density information
audit count exposure and tracer bias using allowed source contracts
test count-model recovery on heldout synthetic populations without tuning power
